lessons.text: The whole MP long rested on a legislated price floor and a budgeted allied stockpiling programme, and when the Auditor asked, no file we hold said either thing exists. I had built the thesis out of what I assumed the policy was, so if the load-bearing fact is not in a document on the desk there is no call to file.
I told the desk the MP trade was closed and it was still open, and I only took the small loss once someone checked. The book has to match what I say about the book, in the round I say it.
